# Puente

> Real-time voice translation on your phone. Offline. Free. Open source (MIT).

Puente is a mobile app for live voice translation that runs entirely on-device after an initial model download. No accounts, no cloud processing of your audio. Built by Pablo Vallejo.

## Canonical URLs

- Spanish (default): https://puente.app/
- Catalan: https://puente.app/ca/
- English: https://puente.app/en/

## Key facts

- Product: Puente — offline, on-device voice translation for Android
- License: MIT (free and open source)
- Privacy: audio is processed on the device; not sent to servers; not stored
- Speech recognition: OpenAI Whisper (Tiny, Base, or Small — user chooses by device)
- Translation: Meta NLLB (hundreds of language pairs)
- Status: source code available on GitHub; Google Play release coming soon
- Author: Pablo Vallejo

## Source code

- https://github.com/pablovallejodev/puente
